Storage API

Use the storage API to save small amounts of data on the device. Values are kept until the user clears them or the app removes them.

Methods

get(key)

Returns the value stored under the given key, or undefined when the key does not exist.

Returns: Promise<unknown>

set(key, value)

Stores a value. Existing values for the same key are replaced.

remove(key)
Deletes a single entry.

Errors

CodeMeaning
QUOTA_EXCEEDEDThe device has no space left for this app.
NOT_ALLOWEDStorage is disabled by the user or by policy.

Example

await storage.set('theme', 'dark');

storage.get('theme')
